description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Godagama, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520017
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, extent, location, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including land registrations, property ownership, and land titles, which is the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
